metric.topicDiversity.label: Topic Diversity
metric.topicDiversity.tooltip: How many different subjects you read across.
metric.topicDiversity.description: How evenly your reading spreads across subjects. A high score means a broad diet; a low score means you circle the same few topics.
metric.sourceDiversity.label: Source Diversity
metric.sourceDiversity.tooltip: How many distinct publishers you read.
metric.sourceDiversity.description: The effective number of publishers you rely on. Reading widely across outlets reduces the influence of any single newsroom's framing.
metric.reportingRatio.label: Reporting Ratio
metric.reportingRatio.tooltip: How much of your reading is reporting vs. opinion.
metric.reportingRatio.description: The share of your reading that is factual reporting rather than opinion or commentary. Balance matters — both have a place.
metric.emotionalBalance.label: Emotional Balance
metric.emotionalBalance.tooltip: How calm vs. charged the tone of your reading is.
metric.emotionalBalance.description: How much of your reading leans on fear and outrage versus calm analysis. A charged diet can distort perception over time.
metric.echoChamber.label: Echo Chamber Score
metric.echoChamber.tooltip: How one-sided your political reading is.
metric.echoChamber.description: How balanced your left/right reading is. A higher score means you're less one-sided — you hear more than one side of contested topics.
metric.viewpointBalance.label: Viewpoint Balance
metric.viewpointBalance.tooltip: How evenly you read across the political spectrum.
metric.viewpointBalance.description: How evenly your reading is spread across left, center, and right. Balance here means you encounter the full range of the debate.
metric.openMindedness.label: Open-Mindedness
metric.openMindedness.tooltip: How often you open cross-cutting recommendations.
metric.openMindedness.description: How often you actually open recommendations that cross your usual viewpoint. It measures engagement with the other side, not just exposure to it.
metric.confidence.label: Confidence
metric.confidence.tooltip: How sure the model is about your lean estimates.
metric.confidence.description: How confident the model is in the political-lean estimates behind your report. Lower confidence means the scores rest on fewer clearly-placed articles.
